description: Get the full raw text/HTML content of an SEC filing by its internal filing ID (the `id` on search_sec_filings rows, `filingId` from lookup_accession_number or get_filing_documents). Returns the complete filing document which can be very large (10-K filings can be 1MB+). Use the maxLength parameter to truncate content for previews. The response includes company_name, form_type, filing_date, cik, and accession_number alongside the content. Record-only filings (bodyStored: false) have no body here — open them on sec.gov. To read one exhibit rather than the whole submission, use get_filing_documents or get_filing_exhibits, then get_exhibit_content. For Form 3/4/5, 13F and SCHEDULE 13D/G, get_filing_structured returns parsed fields instead of XML. Coverage: Signal8's archive of SEC EDGAR filings in the archive's held range (see `archiveFrom` in each response; currently from late 2021, expanding back to 2016 as the history backfill fills in), updated through the day. The archive only holds filings from its `archiveFrom` date; before that it holds only a scatter (well under 1% of most years), so ABSENCE BEFORE archiveFrom IS NOT EVIDENCE a filing was never filed — check SEC EDGAR for earlier periods. Some rows are record-only (bodyStored: false — metadata from the EDGAR index with no document body), so their text cannot be read here; open them at their sec.gov URL.

filingId.description: Internal filing ID (numeric). Find via search_sec_filings.

maxLength.description: Truncate content to this many characters. Useful for previewing large filings. Response includes a "truncated" boolean when truncation is applied.

name: get_filing_document
title: Get Filing Document
